text:
lina (partnerships): CloudPartner asked for a lightweight refkit we can hand them this week. Needs: Terraform module, a README for partners, and a tiny CI smoke test. Anyone available to own the draft?

ash (cloud-eng): I can spin up a minimal module under modules/refkit-quickstart. It will provision network + 1 small GPU instance and pull a partner image.

mira (solutions): Make the example copy-pasteable for partners. Put an examples/simple/aws.tf and variables.tf with comments about required secrets.

paul (security): Security checklist: minimum IAM roles, container image scanning (trivy), and an optional KMS integration. We'll add a policy snippet partners can adopt.

nate (pm): Include a marketplace manifest (marketplace.yaml) with fields name, short_description, supported_clouds, arch, license, contact. Automation will pick it up.

ci-bot: CI pipeline queued: refkit-quickstart/ci-12.

ash (cloud-eng): For CI smoke test: terraform init/plan/apply (tiny), wait for /healthz, POST /v1/predict with {"prompt":"ping"}, assert 200, destroy. Add retry loop for readiness.

mira (solutions): Add a `skip_image_build` var and `prebuilt_image` option so partners can provide images and skip our build. Document in README.

lina (partnerships): Great. Owners: Ash (module + example), Mira (README + examples), Paul (security checks), Nate (manifest + publish checklist). Target PR by Thursday EOD, partner dry-run next Tue. I'll coordinate and share the checklist with CloudPartner. :thumbsup:
